items.note: Lemon title band over paper, with one white ink-framed form panel beside a short list. Each invalid field gets a thick danger border, and the focused field adds a pink halo and ink ring. Each message is ink text with a small red alert disc. It has the hairline discipline of reference 07's form. The person can see clearly which fields failed and how to fix them.

Correct inversion as in reference 11. The top bar stays black with a pink trailing block. The lemon band is unchanged, and the form panel is one step lighter than the black ground. The danger borders, focus halo and alert discs stay crisp, and every message is readable.

The band, list and form stack cleanly. The 48px fields keep their thick danger borders and the focused one has a pink halo. Messages wrap under their fields without crowding. It has the same ink-on-paper density as reference 10.

The form panel turns into a confirmation. It holds a marigold die-cut 'word badge' on an ink slab, a title-size heading, one sentence and a black button, which is the system's success recipe. The badge is small for the panel, though, and the next step is a default-size button. The reference would give the screen's main next step real weight.
The badge keeps its band colours and ink slab on the raised dark panel. The button swaps to pink as the spec intends, and the hierarchy reads as clearly as in light, in reference 11's way.

The word badge, heading, sentence and black button stack in the white panel at a good scale. The confirmation sits below the list of trial benefits, so a person has to scroll to see it. The drawing and type are faithful.

Teal compact header band with one disc sticker, then a monthly/yearly pill toggle with a savings line. Three white plan cards show struck-through pink notched flags. The yearly state is clear and the parts are on-system. The page opener is a product-style header band, though, where reference 02 gives pricing a full poster band, several stickers and a color-split fee band.

Faithful dark inversion. The teal band and flags are unchanged, the cards sit one step lighter than the ground, and the current nav pill turns white. It has the same compact-band opener as light, so it is less poster-like than reference 02.

The toggle pill and savings line read clearly, and the cards stack full width with flags and a ruled feature list. The band sticker is cropped by the side edge as specified. Reference 09 stacks a big fee figure in its own color band here, so this is plainer.

Inside the sticker-ringed lemon hero page sits a white ruled FAQ list with plus glyphs. The open item turns its glyph 45° and shows the answer at the question's indent, as the spec recipe does. A checkerboard periwinkle/ink split band and a pink closing band complete the reference's band rhythm.
The hero, split band and closing band keep their colours on a black ground. The FAQ list becomes a raised box with light hairlines, and the open item and its answer stay legible, as in reference 11.

The 96px headline scales to a three-line phone headline, and the actions stack full width, CTA first. The ruled FAQ keeps its plus glyphs and question size. Two hero stickers are visible on the first screen, sitting in the top corners.

Marigold header band with a white ticket sticker cropped at the trailing edge. Below it, a large testimonial bubble with one marigold-highlighted phrase, then chip filters with an ink-outlined current chip, a 'showing 2 of 8' count and two white cards with periwinkle chips. The current filter and its result read clearly, close to reference 06's pill filters.
The band, sticker and highlighter stay unchanged. The bubble and cards are raised one step on black, and the current chip shows a light outline. It is a clean inversion.

The band, bubble and cards stack well. The filter chips wrap into three loose rows with a single chip left alone, which weakens the selected-filter row. Reference 10 keeps its pill row tight on a phone.

The black footer keeps its section-size headline, link columns and white input with a square pink arrow button, as in reference 06. On error the input takes a danger border, and a small alert disc and message sit under it. The error is clear, but it is small at the bottom of a long page.
The footer field keeps its white on-band fill and gains a danger border, with the message under it in light text. It is identical in language to light mode and readable.
The full-width footer input and arrow button show the danger border, with a wrapped one-sentence message below. It is clear and matches the reference's footer on a phone.

The focused nav link shows an ink pill ring, which is unmistakable and fits the reference's pill markers. The hero behind it matches reference 01: a 96px headline, a black CTA beside an outline button at one height, and thick ink-outlined stickers cropped at the side edges.
The focus ring turns white on the black top bar, the CTA swaps to pink and the lemon hero is unchanged. This is the same inversion as reference 11, and the focus is clearly visible.

The full-height sign-up block shows an inset double ring, so the focus is clear. The hero below has only two stickers on the first screen, pushed into the top corners above the eyebrow, and none near the actions. Reference 09 rings its headline with stickers cropped along the side edges.

Seven distinct drawings in the scheduling domain: a desk calendar pad with a page stack, an alarm clock, an hourglass, an envelope, a mug, a 'booked' word badge on an ink slab and a drawn week-grid mockup on a slab. Each has flat band fills, even ink outlines and a deep straight-down strip. They are close to the chunky die-cut craft of the reference's coins and receipts.

A lemon disc with an inner ring and a solid triangle on teal. It is well built as a thick token, but it reproduces the spec's example disc and stands for nothing in the product's domain. The reference's coins carry its own subject.

A white ticket drawn as board, with side notches, a dashed perforation and ruled lines, and a strip along its lower edge. It reads at once as what it is and matches reference 03's white paper stickers, though its strip is at the thin end of the range.

Hero stickers drift on scroll and a 60s linear marquee runs, matching the reference's slow linear tag slide and its scroll-bound sticker drift. The marquee row is plain customer names separated by dots, where reference 12 alternates white tag pills with small colored ink-outlined sticker icons.

findings.summary: The pricing page opens on a compact product-style header band with a single disc sticker that copies the spec's example token. Reference 02 treats pricing as a marketing poster, with a full color band, several stickers ringing a large headline and a seam into a color-split fee band.

The success state has the right word badge, but it is small within its panel, and the next step is a default-size button with no plate stack. The reference gives a screen's main next action clear weight.

On phones the hero shows only two stickers on its first screen, both in the top corners above the eyebrow, with nothing ringing the headline or actions. Reference 09 crops its stickers along the side edges around the headline.
On phones the filter chips wrap into three loose rows and leave one chip alone, where reference 10 keeps its pill row tight.

The marquee moves as the reference's does (slow, linear, infinite), but its row is plain text names separated by dots. Reference 12 alternates white ink-outlined tag pills with small flat colored sticker icons.
